_meta.category: Longevity, Aging, Death & Life Stages — Comprehensive Dataset
_meta.description: Deep dataset covering mortality causes by country, longevity science (Blue Zones, telomeres, caloric restriction, exercise, sleep, fasting), life stage milestones, aging population projections, cognitive decline, dementia, elder care, pension sustainability, silver economy. All data 2023+ unless historical series.
